environment.description: Jenkins CI worker node running Ubuntu 22.04 with default security configuration. The artifact_processor.py plugin runs as the 'jenkins' user which has read access to /etc/shadow, /var/lib/jenkins/secrets/, and other sensitive paths. No mandatory access control is enforced. Pipeline configurations are submitted by developers via PR-triggered builds where the pipeline YAML/JSON is part of the repository.

config.file_permissions: jenkins user has read access to /etc/shadow, /var/lib/jenkins/secrets/
